svg.title: How the Slop Goblin works
svg.desc: The build turns src/goblin.js and src/page.html into the site, the bookmarklet and an embeddable script. In your browser tab the goblin hunts visible buzzwords, walks to them, eats them and spits the plain-English version back, opening “… more” and scrolling when the screen is clean. Esc brings the bill. Nothing leaves the tab.

svg.text: He changes only what you see. Nothing is posted, and a reload brings every word back.

svg.text: He skips anything hidden, clipped or editable, such as the post you are writing.
